name: Sarjapur, Bangalore

local_faqs.question: Health insurance for Sarjapur families?
local_faqs.answer: Family floater 25-30 lakh, Super Top-Up 20 lakh deductible. Covers maternity, OPD, wellness for township hospital access.

local_faqs.answer: Doorstep renewal with zero-depreciation, engine protection, and roadside assistance.
